title: VTG Playboy August 1992 Salute To Housewife Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy magazine from August 1992 featuring a special salute to housewives, complete with the centerfold. This physical magazine is in English and includes illustrations, catering to topics of interest to men, such as photography. The publication is from the United States and is a one-time issue, not a subscription. This collectible item offers a glimpse into the cultural and lifestyle trends of the early 1990s.
